description: PHP source file that handles fetching and processing social media feeds from Twitter and Facebook for integration into SuiteCRM. It includes API calls, feed formatting, duplicate checking, and database insertion logic.

methods.name: check_facebook_login
methods.description: Handles Facebook user login status, retrieves user feed, and manages login/logout URLs.

methods.name: data_insert
methods.description: Inserts Facebook feed data into the sugarfeed database table, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: guid_maker
methods.description: Generates a unique GUID string for database record identifiers.

methods.name: generate_stream
methods.description: Formats Facebook stream data into display strings for activity feed entries.
